# L4 — the application

The L4 work as a NAMED SUBGRAPH, OPT-IN like `L1/`..`L3/` (a downstream layer lists `smart-base.smart-base-L4` in its `enableSubgraphs`), beside them (owner, 2026-11-13: an L4 subgraph for the point-of-care and application skills, processes and tools): what a running application does with a DAK at the point of care, and briefing, building and running one. `L4/graph.json` names what it holds FROM WITHIN: `skills/`, `processes/` and `tools/`. No `schemas/`: the knowledge graph has no L4 layer.

Part of [SMART Base](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-base-L4`, holding `cat-harness`.
